source.process_text_decoding_policy: decode as UTF-8; on UnicodeDecodeError decode as Windows-1252

generation.repository_identity: AI4MDE Studio frozen thesis UI isolation worktree
generation.deterministic_repair_policy: deterministic sketch repair and deterministic compiler execute inside every semantic-deterministic invocation
generation.structured_output_fallback_policy: topology and semantic planners request structured output; each may fall back to unconstrained JSON mode as implemented at the frozen commit
generation.model_identifier_status: OpenAI aliases used by the frozen code; not immutable snapshots
generation.candidate_retry_policy: three permanent candidate slots; maximum 3 complete top-level attempts per slot; accept first adapter-valid ActivityGraph; never retry a successful slot; never inspect evaluation scores

runtime.generation_python_hash_seed: random as defined by the frozen Dockerfile

evaluation.action_normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; underscores and hyphens to spaces; punctuation to spaces; collapse whitespace; trim
evaluation.assignment: lexicographic one-to-one assignment: maximize threshold-eligible cardinality, then total semantic similarity; exact duplicate normalized reference occurrences use precedence order when comparable

small_validation.purpose: pipeline and evaluator validation, not performance estimation

artifacts.attempt_provenance_policy: ordered candidate-aware records after every attempt; preserve terminal slots across resume
artifacts.hash_policy: SHA-256 of every evaluated ActivityGraph; source and configuration artifacts remain independently hashed
